scope: One component trial and 96 previously unseen face groups; old population reviews not repeated

protocol.changedVariable: native connected-component descriptors and explicitly reviewed material-object labels instead of 96px patch presence
protocol.model: one L2-regularized logistic component gate; fixed p>=0.5; existing NumPy only

labels.authority: engineering visible optical material/pores/reflection, not clinical diagnosis
labels.negative: explicitly reviewed local pore/reflection support only

acceptance.objectHit: >=3 original pixels and >=10% of reviewed positive material polygon; not pixel Dice/precision
acceptance.proposalCeiling: Count missing proposals in the full object denominator; classify generator vs gate misses separately
acceptance.positivePreservation: Retain every baseline-hit validation object and every proposal-hit thin-flake validation object
acceptance.negativeSupport: At least 25% lower reviewed-negative active optical area than unchanged native proposal; no individual negative ROI above production-v3 optical area
acceptance.product: Same accepted support for region/overview/map, same anatomical denominators, source colors unchanged, no duplicate pixels; real positive anatomy localization required
acceptance.scale: Record native and half-resolution behavior separately; do not treat rescaled photo as new person

protocol.sourceGroups: Original train/validation groups retained; no patch/source crosses splits; no person-independent claim
